## Topics
- Data types and classes: numeric, character, logical, factor, Date
- Importing CSV and Excel files
- Cleaning messy column names and values
- Recoding with case_when() and forcats
- Ethics: privacy and de-identification of health data

## Learning objectives
By the end of this week you should be able to:

- Diagnose and fix variable type problems
- Import CSV and Excel files with readr / readxl
- Recode and reorder factor levels
- Explain why de-identified data can still put people at risk

## Data
A messy surveillance line list (CSV/Excel, built for the course); `medicaldata::strep_tb`
